scope: ScenePlayer asynchronous lifetime, ReferenceScene retry accounting, parser callback cleanup and navigation ownership. No browser was launched for this review while the root agent reserved its performance window.

baseline_source.role: Schedule two nominally bounded automatic retries
Treat any looping/static notification as success
Publish looping after the first successful dynamic paint
A later paint can still fail

finding.conditions: A renderer prepares successfully and paints its first visible frame, then throws on its next paint every time a new instance is created. This is a synthetic persistent runtime fault, not a claim that the shipped renderer normally throws.
finding.actual_module_method: Node stripTypeScriptTypes(mode=transform) executed the actual ScenePlayer class and ReferenceScene hook/effect body. Only JSX output was removed; imports were injected with actual loadSceneAssets, sampleScene and browserSignals modules. React hooks, image/canvas objects and timers/rAF were deterministic fixtures. The injected renderer contained the fault; retry and cleanup algorithms were not reimplemented.

baseline_result.limit: The harness stopped after six fault cycles. Continued retry follows from the unconditional budget reset on every first looping frame; an infinite-duration browser run was not performed.

finding.authorized_fix: Remove the automatic budget reset from looping/static notifications. Keep a total of two automatic retries for the mounted scene; explicit manual retry and the existing online recovery event reset that budget.
finding.persistent_regression: scripts/tests/test_scene_lifecycle.mjs is owned by the independent source audit agent; its recorded run supplies the permanent regression result.

additional_actual_module_probes.case: Motion preference cancels preparation A, starts B, then A resolves late
additional_actual_module_probes.observed: A's signal is aborted, late A renderer is destroyed once without painting or interrupting B, B reaches looping and is destroyed once on player cleanup.

additional_actual_module_probes.case: Destroy while canonical image is pending, then invoke its saved late onload callback
Preparation timeout fires, then renderer factory resolves late
additional_actual_module_probes.observed: Player publishes failed and aborts preparation; late renderer is destroyed once without painting or changing the failed state.

additional_actual_module_probes.case: Actual index.html parser script callbacks after parser cleanup
additional_actual_module_probes.method: Executed the owned inline parser script through Node vm with captured observer/media/visibility/loadeddata callbacks, called its registered cleanup and then invoked each saved callback.

navigation_review.method: Read-only ownership/dependency inspection, not a new browser observation.
navigation_review.result: SiteShell active-section state is local to the shell and does not key the scene. ReferenceScene player effect depends on definition, renderer factory, retry attempt and inspection time; navigation state is absent from those dependencies.
navigation_review.gap: Final browser navigation identity/phase assertions belong to the separately coordinated browser QA run.

changed: src/features/referenceScene/ReferenceScene.tsx retry accounting and one policy comment
change_boundary.limits: These targeted fault tests do not prove every browser API or allocation failure is handled, do not measure physical-display FPS, and do not establish absolute security.
